name: Queue Sorter
description: Drains the intake queue: drops already-seen items, routes new items to their stream queue by config rules, and releases approved specified issues to the build queue exactly once. Config-driven; no model call.

parameters.key: ={{ $('Config').first().json.keys.seen_prefix }}{{ $('Pop Intake Item').item.json.item.repository_owner }}/{{ $('Pop Intake Item').item.json.item.repository_name }}#{{ $('Pop Intake Item').item.json.item.issue_number }}

parameters.content:
## Queue Sorter

Mechanics only; names come from the config key. Every run: load config, then loop-pop the intake queue (max 500 per run).

Triage path (not yet seen): issues carrying the configured spec label are marked seen and specified without a model call; everything else is routed repo to stream from `streams.rules` / `streams.default` and pushed to `<stream_prefix><stream>`. Bot-authored pull requests are never triaged.

Approval path (seen, specified, no hold label, head of its chain): the build claim `<build_prefix><key>` is an INCR; the first claim wins. Each win counts one attempt in `<build_attempts_prefix><key>` against `build.max_attempts`, then the claim is given `build.claim_minutes` to live and the item goes to the build queue. When the claim expires with the issue still approved and no pull request open, the next pass releases it again (a failed build retries by itself). At the cap: a comment on the issue, the hold label back, both keys deleted, so removing the hold starts fresh.

Feedback and repair items (stage feedback / repair) bypass triage: claimed once per review id or per head SHA + check, repair attempts counted per PR against `repair.max_attempts` (at the cap: a comment on the PR, the needs-triage label on the issue, nothing more), then pushed to the build queue.

parameters.url: =https://api.github.com/repos/{{ $('Pop Intake Item').item.json.item.repository_owner }}/{{ $('Pop Intake Item').item.json.item.repository_name }}/issues/{{ $('Pop Intake Item').item.json.item.issue_number }}/dependencies/blocked_by?per_page=100

parameters.jsCode:
const src = $('Pop Intake Item').item.json.item;
return $input.first().json.refs.map(n => ({ json: { owner: src.repository_owner, repo: src.repository_name, number: n } }));

const open = $input.all().filter(i => i.json.state === 'open').map(i => i.json.number);
return [{ json: { source: 'body', open_blockers: open, head: open.length === 0 } }];

const c = $('Classify Item').item.json;
return { json: { seen_key: c.seen_key, spec_key: c.spec_key, key: c.key } };
